title: We Won First Place at the Supernova Challenge!
summary: We competed among 300+ startups, and won 1st place on our home turf!
description: Ailytics won first place at the Supernova Challenge at GITEX Singapore 2026, competing against more than 300 startups in Asia's largest startup pitch event.
html: We attended GITEX Singapore 2026 and competed in their Supernova Challenge - Asia's largest startup pitch competition. We competed among 300+ startups, and won 1st place on our home turf!
